block_6_midjourney_v6_prompt.prompt_raw: A sleek mobile app UI design of a Driver Partner dispatch console for ride-hailing and food delivery. Top status bar shows: Driver name 'Ba Cường (Xpander 7 Chỗ - 47A-528.39)', active toggle switch 'Đang Bật Nhận Cuốc' in bright emerald green. Upper section has a compact GPS radar map around Krông Pắk. Below is an urgent glowing incoming order popup card: 'CUỐC XE MỚI - ĐÓN TẠI: Chợ TT. Phước An -> TRẢ: BV Vùng Tây Nguyên', passenger note 'Khách đi khám bệnh sáng', fare 50.000đ, driver net payout 42.000đ. Green button 'Nhận Ngay' and grey 'Bỏ qua'. Bottom shows wallet balance '1.250.000đ' with 'Rút Về Napas 247'. High-contrast dark mode slate #0F172A, professional driver telematics UI, crisp typography, 8k --ar 9:16 --v 6.0

block_7_dalle3_flux_sdxl_prompts.dalle_3: Driver partner mobile application screen for ride-hailing and food delivery. Top status bar shows driver name, vehicle plate, and online green toggle. Middle features a map radar and an urgent incoming ride order card with origin, destination, fare of 50.000đ, and big green 'Nhận Ngay' button. Bottom shows driver digital wallet balance of 1.250.000đ with Napas withdrawal button. Dark slate theme, high visibility.
block_7_dalle3_flux_sdxl_prompts.flux_sdxl: driver telematics interface, mobile app UI, dark mode #090D16, neon green accents #00B14F, GPS radar map, incoming ride notification card, financial wallet widget, high contrast for outdoor visibility, professional software engineering, Figma presentation
block_7_dalle3_flux_sdxl_prompts.negative_prompt: blurry, low contrast, daytime glare, toy car, unreadable numbers, messy wiring, complex unusable UI
